title: Entity behavior
responsibility: Reads recorded behavior artifacts and presents current or compared end-to-end results with entity reasons.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.behavior
inputs.description: Required metadata for recorded rows before their contents are read. Row before/after hashes form the identity used to retain a completed reading.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.read
inputs.description: Optional already-read behavior, default null. Non-null bypasses local reading; null means no preloaded result and does not itself indicate failure.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.scope
inputs.description: Required mode, commit and parent context. Paired panes require commit behavior with a parent.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required base used by the artifact-reading helper and passed to run panels.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.nav
inputs.description: Required route context and navigation callbacks for full tests and selected-commit links.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.reasons
inputs.description: Optional entity change reasons, displayed separately from test observations. Supplied behavior text remains visible while recorded results load and takes precedence over derived comparison explanation. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted).

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.duration
inputs.description: Optional displayed end-to-end duration, defaulting to Not measured; the component does not calculate it. Defaults to Not measured.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed to run/artifact case rendering. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

outputs.name: EntityBehavior
outputs.description: Current or before/after test panel. Reads artifacts when not supplied and ignores completion whose row-hash signature no longer matches. Pending reading omits settled reason-absence text; completed explanations use separate paragraphs. Missing groups are explicit. Shows scenario outcomes, duration, original reasons and navigation. A passing current/unchanged verdict requires passing results. Footer outcome values stay together. States: initial: The selected initial commit is shown without a parent comparison. empty: No behavior rows or scenarios are recorded and an empty message is shown. changed: The comparison highlights changed output fields between the two revisions. loading: The panel shows pending artifact reads instead of verified behavior contents.

errors.name: Recorded result read failure
errors.description: A rejected artifact read produces Behavior unknown and the recorded-results read gap; it is not reported as unchanged behavior.

errors.name: Caller navigation or rendering error
errors.description: Exceptions in caller navigation or rendered dependencies propagate; this component is not an error boundary.
